name: Technology of Textile Coating and Lamination
description: Materials for coating, polymers, textile materials, adhesives, compounding of polymers for coating, methods of coating, films for lamination, methods of lamination, technical products based on coating/lamination, coated and laminated textile products, environmental aspects of coating/lamination, laboratory experiments include coating of fabrics with PVC, PU, acrylic, EVA, silicones, PTFE polymers, rubber coating, etc., and basic lamination with films.
